prompt: Subject: A step onto the blue sky. Main Subject: A 3:4 vertical outdoor fashion photograph. A woman is positioned slightly above the center of the screen, posing at a bold low angle looking up from near the ground. The single leg stretching from the bottom left to the top right is shown the largest, with the leg and gold sandals occupying about half of the foreground. The face and upper body are placed near the top center of the screen, leaving a wide margin of blue sky above the head. Person/Expression: Bright ivory-beige white skin with natural texture and a faint pink glow. Delicate highlights on the cheeks, tip of the nose, shoulders, collarbones, and light-receiving surfaces of the legs. Pale rose blush, champagne beige and pink-brown eye makeup, long thin eyelashes, natural eye bags, soft bright eyebrows, and transparent pink-beige lips. A calm and confident expression looking at the camera, with the chin slightly tucked. Medium-long milk tea ash brown hair, thin see-through bangs, layers around the face, inward-curled ends, and natural stray hairs. Clothing/Pose: A light ivory-white camisole mini dress. Thin shoulder straps, low-luster satin fabric, and a tiered structure of about three layers with delicate floral lace on the chest and hem. The hem is short, covering the upper part of the thighs, but ensures a length and volume that completely hides the waist area and interior even from a low angle, naturally covered with an inner skirt of the same color. One leg is stretched greatly toward the camera, and the body is supported by the other leg. One hand lightly touches the side of the dress near the waist, and the other hand has the fingers softly interlaced in front of the face, with the pinky finger near the lips. Gold thin strap sandals, elegant heels, and a reddish pedicure. Background/Lighting: Clear deep blue midsummer sky and small white clouds. Dark green trees are placed on the right and bottom of the screen, and a dark gray metal structure on the bottom left. Strong natural light from a high position illuminates the front-left side of the person, creating a clear gloss on the skin and satin. Tight shadows are cast on the back of the legs and the overlapping parts of the dress, with blue ambient light from the sky and weak reflected light from the ground added. Composition/Camera: Ultra-low angle just above the ground, wide-angle around 24mm. Strong perspective showing the toes in the foreground large and the face slightly small. The extended leg runs diagonally from bottom-left to top-right, and the lines of the metal structure and the leg guide the gaze to the face. Focus accurately on the face and eyes, while sufficiently resolving the sandals and legs in the foreground. Take a wide margin of the sky in the upper half and limit the trees to the left and right edges. Texture/Style: A sophisticated live-action photograph reminiscent of Japanese fashion magazines. Clear color contrast of vivid blue sky, near-pure white ivory, deep green, and gold. Precisely depict natural skin texture, thin hair flow, satin reflections, lace transparency, and embroidery. High contrast due to strong sunlight, but suppress blown-out highlights and maintain a sense of cleanliness and realistic texture. Negative: People who look like minors, excessive leg elongation, extra fingers, missing fingers, fusion of hands and feet, broken joints, poor contact with sandals, floating, unnatural gravity, exposure of underwear, exposure around the waist, overly transparent costumes, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with the light source, blown-out highlights, plastic-like skin, text, logos, watermarks.

promptZh: 主体：迈向蓝天。主要内容：一张 3:4 的竖构图户外时尚摄影作品。女性位于画面中心偏上方，采用大胆的低角度仰拍姿势。从左下角延伸至右上角的一条腿被放大展示，腿部和金色凉鞋占据了前景约一半的位置。面部和上半身位于画面顶部中心，头顶上方留有大面积的蓝天。人物/表情：明亮的象牙米白色皮肤，具有自然质感和淡淡的粉色光泽。脸颊、鼻尖、肩膀、锁骨以及腿部受光面有细腻的高光。淡玫瑰色腮红，香槟米色和粉棕色眼妆，细长的睫毛，自然的卧蚕，柔和明亮的眉毛，以及透明的粉米色嘴唇。表情冷静自信，注视着镜头，下巴微收。中长款奶茶灰棕色头发，轻薄的空气刘海，脸部周围有层次感，发尾内扣，带有自然的碎发。服装/姿势：一件浅象牙白吊带迷你裙。细肩带，低光泽缎面材质，三层叠层结构，胸部和下摆饰有精致的花卉蕾丝。裙摆较短，覆盖大腿上部，但长度和蓬松度确保即使在低角度下也能完全遮盖腰部和内部，并自然地覆盖了同色的内衬裙。一条腿向镜头方向大幅伸展，身体由另一条腿支撑。一只手轻轻触碰腰部附近的裙边，另一只手的手指在脸前轻柔交叠，小指靠近嘴唇。金色细带凉鞋，优雅的高跟，涂有红色的脚趾甲油。背景/光影：清澈的深蓝色盛夏天空和少量白云。画面右侧和底部有深绿色树木，左下角有一个深灰色金属结构。来自高位的强自然光照亮了人物的左前方，在皮肤和缎面上形成清晰的光泽。腿部后侧和裙子重叠部分投下浓重的阴影，并加入了来自天空的蓝色环境光和来自地面的微弱反射光。构图/相机：贴近地面的超低角度，约 24mm 广角。强烈的透视效果使得前景的脚趾显得很大，而脸部略小。伸展的腿部从左下角向右上角呈对角线延伸，金属结构的线条和腿部引导视线看向面部。焦点准确对准面部和眼睛，同时前景的凉鞋和腿部也保持足够清晰。上半部分留出大面积天空，树木仅限于左右边缘。质感/风格：一张令人联想到日本时尚杂志的精致实拍照片。鲜艳的蓝天、近乎纯净的象牙白、深绿色和金色的色彩对比鲜明。精准描绘自然的皮肤纹理、细发流向、缎面反光、蕾丝透明度和刺绣细节。强烈的阳光带来高对比度，但抑制了高光溢出，保持了洁净感和真实的质感。负面提示词：看起来像未成年人、腿部过度拉长、多余的手指、手指缺失、手脚融合、关节断裂、凉鞋接触不良、漂浮、不自然的重力、内衣走光、腰部走光、服装过于透明、透视错误、阴影与光源不一致、高光溢出、塑料感皮肤、文字、Logo、水印。
